method.cpu: Arithmetic mean of non-null outer hardware samples at elapsed_seconds >= 5; one sample per approximately one second, not a time-weighted integral.
method.temperature_and_throttling: All telemetry rows captured during the trial, including startup; monitoring may finish before resource cleanup completes.
method.cpu_process_unit: Percent of one logical core; 100 means one core.
method.cpu_system_unit: Percent of total system capacity across all logical cores; not obtained by dividing process CPU.
method.null: Missing values excluded, never interpreted as zero.
